text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Friday chaired a cabinet meeting on energy sector.

- President Ben Ali sends message to Algerian President Liamine Zeroual to commemorate the 39th anniversary of the bombing of the Tunisian border village of Sakiet Sidi Youssef by France during the Algerian independence battle.
- The social security fund has 158,000 members.
- Tunisian and Algerian businessmen say they would give priority to the import of Maghreb-made products.
- Tunisia to celebrate Eid al-Fitr on Sunday.
